roleContext.roleTitle: Data Scientist, Fresh Food Demand Forecasting
roleContext.jobDescription: A grocery retailer with 300 stores is strengthening its demand forecasting for chilled and fresh food, where short shelf lives make over-ordering expensive and under-ordering empties shelves by mid-afternoon. The data scientist builds store-SKU forecasts, measures accuracy by category, maintains the promotions and weather feature pipeline and documents model assumptions for the supply planning team. The role also presents forecast recommendations to the category directors at the weekly ordering meeting, so that ordering decisions reflect what the models show rather than last year's pattern.

requirements.text: Builds weekly demand forecasts at store-SKU level in Python.
Measures forecast accuracy (WAPE, bias) and reports it by category.
Presents forecast recommendations to category directors and influences ordering decisions.
Maintains the feature pipeline for promotions and weather data.
Documents model assumptions for the supply planning team.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Data Scientist, Fresh Food Demand Forecasting

## Experience

- Data scientist at Orchard Lane Foods (grocery retail), August 2021 to present, building weekly store-SKU demand forecasts with gradient-boosted models in Python for the chilled and fresh categories.
- Reported weighted absolute percentage error and bias by category every week, and flagged any category whose bias stayed above five percent for two weeks running.
- Maintained the feature pipeline that joins the promotions calendar and regional weather forecasts to the sales history, with checks for missing promotion records before each training run.
- Sent the weekly forecast exception list to the category planning analysts, who took it into the ordering meetings with the category directors.
- Wrote the model assumptions page for the supply planning team, covering bank-holiday handling, promotion uplift and cold starts for new products.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the assessor's comment sheet from the candidate's mock forecast-review presentation on the assessment day: 'Lacks gravitas with the business; far too quiet to win over our category directors. Seemed more at home with the charts than with the people in the room, and I could not picture them pushing back on a buyer.'
